scope: Durability, cross-chat recovery, code portability, shard identity binding, lossless derived-artifact preservation and promotion continuity for the current GA1 state. This audit does not claim economic alpha or complete the remaining GA1 shards.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Certified V225/V227 accelerated wrappers contained absolute transient /mnt/data paths, making the committed code non-portable across chats/runtimes even though historical executed bytes/results remained valid.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Repository-relative V233 wrappers with exact dependency Git-blob guards.
findings_and_corrections.verification: Byte-exact parity on frozen NQX/BUY/H4 real groups 0 and 1, including counts, roots and artifact SHA-256.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Cross-chat continuity existed as policy/pointer text but had no machine fail-closed authority graph preflight.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Cross-chat resume preflight V234 validates stable/target binding, authority existence, ledger/completion identity equality, shard/config/semantic/alias roots, checkpoint progress, rematerialization domain set, portable wrapper blobs and economic firewalls.
findings_and_corrections.verification: Positive fixture PASS; alias-root mutation FAIL; missing hardening-policy FAIL.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Promotion ledger v1 did not uniformly contain shard_id, ordered config root and full alias-map root for every completed shard.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Promotion ledger v2 normalizes strong identities and storage/rematerialization authority for all four promoted shards while preserving v1 historically.
findings_and_corrections.verification: Identities reconciled to completion receipts; H2 exact completion independently re-read from main.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Large derived bytes were intentionally not persisted to GitHub but reconstruction authority was distributed across several receipts.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Single deterministic rematerialization manifest binds exact DEV bytes, cache receipts, builder/oracle/worker commits, portable wrappers and per-shard scientific/storage roots.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Historical XAU/BUY/M1 completion depended on an old merge envelope that predated generic domain binding; forcing a new global pack would be expensive and scientifically unnecessary.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Re-merge the original 24 group artifacts with generic V228 merger and independent oracle; preserve old V224 receipt and 24-zstd representation rather than forcing storage normalization.
findings_and_corrections.verification: V228 reproduces exactly 804672 configs, 303572 classes, config root 96d664f4..., semantic root cf28be12..., alias root 4151cccd....

findings_and_corrections.finding: Engineering lessons from this first campaign were campaign-local and could regress in future sharded campaigns.
findings_and_corrections.correction: General sharded execution hardening policy freezes portability, parity-before-optimization, generic domain binding, lossless cleanup, resume preflight, rematerialization and economic-firewall rules.

known_residuals_not_classified_as_critic: H4 is not yet a completed/promoted shard: V228 merge, independent oracle, mask preservation/pack and promotion are still pending.
56 of 60 GA1 shards remain scientifically uncompleted after the four formal completions; this is campaign progress, not missing durability authority.
Large derived mask binaries are not GitHub-resident. They are accepted only through exact hashes and deterministic rematerialization authority; a future runtime may need to rematerialize them.

XAUUSD/BUY/M1 retains the historical 24-group zstd representation instead of the NQX global unique-mask pack. Modern V228 re-merge parity proves scientific equivalence; storage normalization is optional, not a gate.

The V234 preflight has executable positive/negative regression coverage. This runtime could not network-clone GitHub into the local container, so the full preflight was not executed against a fresh local clone of main here; the current authority graph was instead re-read directly from GitHub connector sources during this audit.
No audit can prove absence of unknown future bugs; the decision below applies to known, tested durability/portability gaps in the current state.
resume_rule: New chats/runtimes must read control/QROS_PUBLIC_1000_CURRENT_FRONTIER_POINTER.json, recover its versioned target, execute the referenced cross-chat resume preflight and proceed only on PASS. Chat memory is not authority.
